festivals: Vasco Saptah (Damodar Bhajani Saptah, 6th day of Shravan - July/August)

history.period: Modern; the Vasco Saptah tradition began in 1899
history.summary: CSV name 'Damodar Temple (Vasco branch)' is loose: the Vasco shrine is the venue of the Vasco Saptah (Damodar Bhajani Saptah), housed in the original large hall of the Joshi family's house at Swatantra Path near Children's Park / Municipal Garden, Vasco. Every year on the sixth day of Shravana (July/August), a shreephal (sacred coconut) is brought from the parent Shri Damodar Sansthaan at Zambaulim (see seq 226 and 229) and installed here at noon, followed by 24 hours of continuous bhajan; afterwards it is carried to Khariwada beach and immersed in the sea. A large fair runs in Vasco for about seven days. Related to - but a distinct shrine from - the Zambaulim temple; not a formal administrative branch.

name: Damodar Temple (Vasco branch)
town_description: Vasco da Gama, in Mormugao taluka, South Goa, is Goa's principal port city, about 30 km from Panaji and adjacent to Dabolim international airport. It is a working port and naval town whose biggest religious-cultural event is the annual Vasco Saptah at the Damodar temple.

travel.railway: Vasco da Gama railway station (~2 km) (verify)
travel.road: Near Municipal Garden and Children's Park on Vasco Road, off NH-566; city buses from Dabolim and Margao (verify)

visitor_information.best_time: July/August for Vasco Saptah (Shravan); October-March otherwise
